title: Maintaining IoT Device Identification under Concept Drift via Budget-Aware Traffic Labeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.15465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identification of IoT device types from passive traffic is increasingly used for security management in enterprise and ISP networks. However, the performance of machine learning-based classifiers gradually degrades under concept drift as device behavior evolves. Therefore, maintaining classification performance requires periodic retraining with newly labeled deployment traffic. The operational challenge is determining how much and which deployment traffic instances to label for maintaining classification performance. We show that these two decisions should be treated separately. While retraining solely on instances selected by a drift detector is prone to systematically overlooking parts of the emerging behavioral space, uniformly sampled deployment traffic captures more representative behavioral changes. translated_title: 在概念漂移下通过预算感知的流量标注维持物联网设备识别
translated_abstract: 摘要：从被动流量中识别物联网设备类型正越来越多地用于企业和ISP网络的安全管理。然而，随着设备行为的演变，基于机器学习的分类器在概念漂移下的性能会逐渐下降。因此，维持分类性能需要定期使用新标注的部署流量进行重新训练。操作上的挑战在于确定需要标注多少以及哪些部署流量实例以维持分类性能。我们表明，这两个决策应分开处理。虽然仅对漂移检测器选择的实例进行重新训练容易系统性地忽略新兴行为空间的部分，但均匀采样的部署流量能捕捉更具代表性的行为变化。相反，漂移检测在确定应标注的部署流量数量方面更为有效。我们做出了三项贡献...
tldr: 本文提出将流量标注的数量与选择决策分离，利用漂移检测确定标注规模，均匀采样捕捉代表性行为变化，以在概念漂移下高效维持物联网设备识别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper separates the decisions of labeling quantity and instance selection, using drift detection to determine labeling budget and uniform sampling to capture representative behavioral changes, thereby efficiently maintaining IoT device identification performance under concept drift.
